title: S3 Tables (Iceberg) table definition
description: Schema for a single table definition file at s3tables/tables/<name>.yaml. One file describes exactly one table. File location has no bearing on which namespace the table belongs to - that comes entirely from metadata.namespace.

namespace.description: Namespace this table belongs to. Must match the `metadata.name` of a namespace YAML file under s3tables/namespaces/. The table inherits its deployment environments from that namespace.

owner.description: Team or individual responsible for this table. Informational only - not consumed by Terraform.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this table is for. Informational only - not consumed by Terraform.

format.description: Always ICEBERG - this is the only table format AWS S3 Tables supports. Present for documentation/consistency only; not read by Terraform (the resource always creates format = "ICEBERG" regardless of this field).

schema.description: Column definitions. Omit entirely (or leave `columns` empty) to create a schema-less Iceberg table. NOTE: changing this after the table exists forces a destroy-and-recreate, which prevent_destroy will refuse.

type.description: Apache Iceberg primitive type. Complex/nested types (struct, list, map) exist in the Iceberg spec but are NOT supported by the aws_s3tables_table resource. Parameterized types must be quoted in YAML, e.g. "decimal(10,2)".

oneOf.title: decimal(precision,scale)
oneOf.description: Fixed-point decimal. Precision 1-38, scale 0-38 and not greater than precision.

required.description: true if the column does not allow nulls. Defaults to false (nullable) when omitted.

comment.description: Human-readable note about this column. Informational only - not consumed by Terraform (the AWS provider's schema field block has no doc/comment attribute).

encryption.description: Per-table server-side encryption override. If omitted, the table inherits the bucket's encryption. NOTE: changing this after the table exists forces a destroy-and-recreate, which prevent_destroy will refuse.

sse_algorithm.description: AES256 for S3-managed keys, or aws:kms for KMS-managed keys.

kms_key_arn.description: ARN of the KMS key to use. Required when sse_algorithm is aws:kms, and only valid in that case.

policy.description: Resource-based IAM policy for this table only, as a raw JSON document string (use a YAML block scalar). Terraform additionally validates that this parses as JSON.

replication.description: Replicates this table to one or more destination table buckets. The IAM role is NOT created by this module - it must already exist with the permissions S3 Tables replication requires.

role.description: ARN of the IAM role S3 assumes to perform replication.

destinations.description: Destination table bucket ARN(s). One replication rule is created per entry.
